signals.name: Elite jockey on bomb
signals.description: Top-3 meet rider chooses a >12/1 horse over shorter-priced mounts. They know something.
signals.detection: Identify the top-5 jockeys at the current meet by win count from their stats (format: "JOCKEY NAME (starts wins 2nds 3rds pct)"). Top riders include Ortiz Jr, Prat, Saez L, Gaffalione, Ortiz JL. If any top-5 jockey is riding a horse whose ML or live odds is 12/1 or higher, this signal FIRES (+3).
signals.dataNote: Jockey name and ML odds are always in the DRF data.

signals.name: Late tote action
signals.description: Horse drops 3+ points from ML by post time. Sharp money = information.
signals.detection: Compare the LIVE ODDS field (if entered) to the ML odds. If live odds are 3+ points shorter than ML (e.g., ML 8/1 → Live 5/1), this signal FIRES (+3). If no live odds entered, this signal CANNOT be evaluated.
signals.dataNote: Requires live odds entered manually before execution. Not available from DRF PDF alone.

signals.name: Odds drift on quality
signals.description: Was fav or co-fav on ML, now drifted to 4/1+. Form didn't change, just money flow. Gift.
signals.detection: Check if horse was ML favorite or co-favorite (lowest/tied-lowest ML in field). Then check LIVE ODDS — if live odds have drifted to 4/1 or higher, this signal FIRES (+2). Requires live odds to evaluate drift.
signals.dataNote: Requires live odds entered manually. ML is in DRF but drift requires live comparison.

signals.name: Hot barn at a price
signals.description: Trainer win% >15% at meet running a horse at >6/1. Barn cashing regardless of perception.
signals.detection: In the trainer stats (format: "Trainer Name (starts wins 2nds 3rds pct)"), read the pct value (last number, e.g. .17 = 17%). If pct >= .15 AND the horse ML or live odds is 6/1 or higher, this signal FIRES (+2).
signals.dataNote: Trainer win% and ML are both in DRF data.

signals.name: Distance stretch to sire sweet spot
signals.description: Horse getting their sire's optimal distance for the first time. Pedigree unlocking.
signals.detection: Check the sire name and the race distance. Research the sire's progeny stats — if this sire's winners peak at today's distance AND the horse has never run this distance before (check past race distances in running lines), this signal FIRES (+2). Common examples: Candy Ride progeny excel at 9f+, Into Mischief at 7f-8.5f.
signals.dataNote: Sire is in DRF data. Sire distance stats require general knowledge. Horse distance history is in running lines but may be truncated.

signals.name: Best Beyer in field
signals.description: Highest speed figure among live starters. Proven fastest horse in here.
signals.detection: Find the Beyer Speed Figure for each horse (listed as "Beyer XX" in notes or extracted from past performance lines). The horse with the single highest Beyer figure among live starters gets this signal FIRED (+1).
signals.dataNote: Beyer figures are in the DRF data for each horse.

signals.name: Blinkers change
signals.description: Trainer making an equipment move = intent. Something different today.
signals.detection: Look for "FIRST TIME BLINKERS", "Blinkers ON", or "Blinkers OFF" notation in the horse data. Any blinker equipment change (adding or removing) triggers this signal FIRES (+1).
signals.dataNote: Blinker changes are noted in DRF program data.

signals.name: Track bias alignment
signals.description: Horse's running style (speed/stalker/closer) matches today's track pattern.
signals.detection: Determine each horse's running style from their past race descriptions (pressed/led = speed, stalked/tracked = stalker, rallied/closed = closer). Then check if today's early race results favor a particular style. If the horse's style matches the emerging bias, FIRE (+1). If no races run yet today, cannot evaluate.
signals.dataNote: Requires observation of today's early race results. Not available from DRF PDF or before races begin. Toggle off for early races.

signals.name: Earnings leader in class
signals.description: Most $ earned among starters at this class level. Proven they belong.
signals.detection: Parse lifetime earnings from each horse (format: "$XX,XXX" or "$XXK" in life stats). The horse with the highest lifetime earnings among live starters gets this signal FIRED (+1). Note: In claimers, high earnings can mean inconsistency — use with context.
signals.dataNote: Lifetime earnings are in DRF life record for every horse.

signals.name: First-timer + expensive pedigree
signals.description: FTS with $100K+ stud fee or purchase price. Connections paid up and expect a run.
signals.detection: Check if horse has 0 lifetime starts (Life: 0-0-0-0 or "FTS"). If yes, check sire stud fee (listed after sire name, e.g. "$250,000") or auction purchase price (e.g. "KEESEP23 $150,000"). If stud fee >= $100K OR purchase price >= $100K, this signal FIRES (+1).
signals.dataNote: FTS status, sire fee, and purchase price are all in DRF data.

signals.name: Good jockey / good trainer on bad horse
signals.description: Top connections on a horse the public has dismissed. They see something the market doesn't.
signals.detection: Identify top-tier jockeys (Ortiz Jr, Prat, Saez L, Gaffalione, Ortiz JL) and top-tier trainers (Cox, Baffert, Asmussen, Walsh, Walden, McPeek, Pletcher, Maker, McCarthy, Sharp, Jacobson). If BOTH jockey AND trainer are top-tier but the horse is 8/1 or higher, the public is dismissing a horse that elite connections chose to run. FIRES (+2).
signals.dataNote: Jockey name, trainer name, and ML odds are all in DRF data.

rules.name: Win never the favorite
rules.description: Win bet is never the chalk. We find value — the fav goes in exotics only.

rules.name: Win must be 7/2+
rules.description: Win bet must be at least 7/2 odds. If our pick moves below that, pivot.

rules.name: Trifecta minimum 4 horses
rules.description: No 3-horse tri boxes (0/6 day one). Need width — 4 or 5 horse boxes.

rules.name: Fav always in exotics
rules.description: The favorite is always included in exacta and trifecta — they hit the board too often to exclude.

rules.name: Scratches require full rebuild
rules.description: Don't just remove — re-evaluate pace, bias, and who benefits from the scratch.

rules.name: Tri must include exacta horses
rules.description: Trifecta box ALWAYS contains the same horses as the exacta box. Never split them. (Added 5/30 — Mike's Mistake)

win.name: Delancey Street
win.reason: Highest signal score at 5 points. Gaffalione/Casse are elite connections that don't waste FTS entries — both B1 and B11 fired. Street Sense sire can get 6.5f. At 12/1 this is exceptional value for a horse that could easily be 6/1 or 7/2 based on connections alone.

result.notes: If #8 takes heavy late money and drops below 7/1, pivot win bet to #9 Gadget Play (Into Mischief $250K with Saez at 8/1). If #11 scratches, rebuild entirely — the favorite scratch changes the whole dynamic.
result.analysis: This maiden sprint sets up as a debut-horse lottery, but the connections tell the story. Campobasso (Prat/Baffert) is rightfully favored at 4/1 and must be in all exotics. Study (McCarthy hot trainer) at 5/1 is the logical second choice. But the value play is Delancey Street at 12/1 — Gaffalione and Casse on an FTS is a 'good jockey/good trainer on bad odds' situation. They chose this horse, they entered it here, and the public is dismissing it. Gadget Play adds exotic depth with his $250K Into Mischief pedigree and Saez, while Civic Charm (Mott) gives us another proven barn at a price. Five-horse trifecta provides the width Rule R3 demands after the 3-horse box failures on day one.

signalBreakdown.reasoning: Gaffalione (elite, top-3 meet rider) on #8 Delancey Street at 12/1. Elite jockey choosing a double-digit FTS over shorter-priced mounts signals insider confidence.
No live odds data available from DRF PDF. Cannot evaluate late tote action without manual odds input at post time.
Cannot evaluate odds drift without live odds comparison to morning line. Requires manual input.
Asmussen at 16% win rate (exceeds 15% threshold) running #12 Interrogator at 15/1. Hot barn angle fires, though the Beyer 25 from debut is concerning.
No horses stretching to optimal sire distance. 6.5f is standard sprint range for all these pedigrees. Street Sense and Into Mischief can handle it, but no unlocking distance stretch scenario.
#3 Impractical has best proven Beyer at 73 among horses with race history. #1 shows 85 but that appears to be projection for FTS, not earned figure.
#2 McCann explicitly noted as 'FIRST TIME BLINKERS' with Ortiz Jr. Equipment change signals trainer intent to wake this horse up.
Cannot evaluate without observing today's early race results. Track bias requires pattern recognition from completed races. Not available for analysis yet.
#4 Hawkeye State leads field with $33K lifetime earnings despite no wins. Most proven at this class level by bankroll metric.
#9 Gadget Play is Into Mischief FTS with $250K purchase price explicitly noted. Expensive pedigree signal fires — connections paid premium and expect performance.

#8 Delancey Street has BOTH Gaffalione (elite jockey) AND Casse (elite trainer) at 12/1. When top-tier connections both choose a horse the public has at 8/1+, they see value the market doesn't. Textbook B11.
